pairs: Facies quoque altare ad adolendum thymiama,
“You shall also make an altar, for the burning of incense,
Horns shall proceed from the same.
And you shall clothe it with the purest gold,
Faciesque ei coronam aureolam per gyrum,
And you shall make for it a crown of gold in a circle,
et duos annulos aureos sub corona per singula latera,
and two gold rings under the crown on each side,
so that the bars may be set in them
and the altar may be carried.
Ipsos quoque vectes facies de lignis setim, et inaurabis.
Also, you shall make its bars of setim wood, and you shall overlay them with gold.
And you shall set the altar opposite the veil,
quod ante arcum pendet testimonii coram propitiatorio quo tegitur testimonium,
which hangs in front of the ark of the testimony, before the propitiatory with which the testimony is covered,
where I will speak to you.
Et adolebit incensum super eo Aaron,
And Aaron shall burn incense upon it,
et quando collocabit eas ad vesperum,
And when he assembles them in the evening,
uret thymiama sempiternum coram Domino in generationes vestras.
he shall burn an everlasting incense before the Lord throughout your generations.
Non offeretis super eo thymiama compositionis alterius,
You shall not offer upon it incense of another composition,
Et deprecabitur Aaron super cornua ejus semel per annum,
And Aaron shall pray over its horns once a year,
in sanguine quod oblatum est pro peccato,
with the blood of what was offered for sin.
et placabit super eo in generationibus vestris.
And he shall make atonement over it in your generations.
It shall be the Holy of holies to the Lord.”
And the Lord spoke to Moses,
Quando tuleris summam filiorum Israël juxta numerum,
“When you have taken the sum of the sons of Israel, according to their number,
dabunt singuli pretium pro animabus suis Domino,
each shall give a price for their souls to the Lord,
et non erit plaga in eis,
and there will be no scourge among them,
Hoc autem dabit omnis qui transit ad nomen,
Then all those who pass shall give by name:
dimidium sicli juxta mensuram templi (siclus viginti obolos habet);
one half shekel, according to the measure at the temple. A shekel has twenty obols.
The half part of a shekel shall be offered to the Lord.
Qui habetur in numero, a viginti annis et supra, dabit pretium.
He who has been numbered from twenty years and above shall give the price.
Dives non addet ad medium sicli,
The rich shall not add to the half shekel,
and the poor shall diminish nothing.
quæ collata est a filiis Israël,
which was collected from the sons of Israel,
you shall deliver for the uses of the tabernacle of the testimony,
ut sit monimentum eorum coram Domino,
so that it may be a memorial of them before the Lord,
and he may act favorably toward their souls.”
And the Lord spoke to Moses,
Facies et labrum æneum cum basi sua ad lavandum:
“You shall also make a bronze washtub with its base to wash in;
ponesque illud inter tabernaculum testimonii et altare.
and you shall place it between the tabernacle of the testimony and the altar.
And when water has been added,
lavabunt in ea Aaron et filii ejus manus suas ac pedes,
Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and feet in it:
when they enter the tabernacle of the testimony,
et quando accessuri sunt ad altare, ut offerant in eo thymiama Domino,
and when they approach to the altar so as to offer incense to the Lord upon it,
This shall be an everlasting law to him,
and to his offspring, throughout their successions.”
And the Lord spoke to Moses,
of the first and best myrrh,
and of cinnamon half as much,
of sweet flag similarly two hundred and fifty,
five hundred shekels by the weight of the sanctuary,
and of the oil of olives the measure of a hin.
And you shall make the holy oil of unction,
an ointment composed with the skills of a perfumer,
et unges ex eo tabernaculum testimonii,
and with it you shall anoint the tabernacle of the testimony,
and the ark of the testament,
and the table with its vessels,
et universam supellectilem quæ ad cultum eorum pertinet.
and all the items that pertain to their rituals.
and they shall be the Holy of holies.
He who will touch them must be sanctified.
You shall anoint Aaron and his sons,
so that they may exercise the priesthood for me.
Likewise, you shall say to the sons of Israel:
Hoc oleum unctionis sanctum erit mihi in generationes vestras.
‘This oil of unction will be holy to me throughout your generations.
Caro hominis non ungetur ex eo,
The flesh of man shall not be anointed from it,
et juxta compositionem ejus non facietis aliud,
and you shall not make any similar compound,
and it shall be holy to you.
Whatever man will have composed such a thing
and have given it to a stranger,
he shall be exterminated from his people.’”
And the Lord said to Moses:
all these shall be of equal weight.
And you shall make incense composed with the skills of a perfumer,
Cumque in tenuissimum pulverem universa contuderis,
And when you have crushed all these into a very fine powder,
pones ex eo coram tabernaculo testimonii,
you shall place some of it before the tabernacle of the testimony,
in the place where I will appear to you.
The Holy of holies shall this incense be to you.
Talem compositionem non facietis in usus vestros,
You shall not make such a compound for your own uses,
because it is holy to the Lord.
Whatever man will have made anything similar,
so as to thoroughly enjoy its smell,
he shall perish from his people.”
